why: §275.4 A block reference's target cannot hold `)`, `#` or `|` (BLOCK_REF_RE's `[^)#|]*?`), so the frontend percent-escapes them, and `%` first so the escape round-trips (TARGET_ESCAPE_PAIRS, escapeBlockRefTarget and unescapeBlockRefTarget in src/pipeline/block-id.ts). The link index reads a target the same way and a rename writes one the same way (index/block_ref_escape.rs). Both read this file.

cases.why: a literal percent sign is escaped first
a name that already reads like an escape round-trips

unescape_only.why: the escapes are upper case; a lower-case one is text
a percent sign not followed by an escape is text
